verified_behaviors: Product pagination executes a bounded SELECT without catalog COUNT, SKU join or snapshot aggregation.
Current statistics match the original builder, including currency, shop, category and unknown-price scopes.
Expired statistics keep the last successful payload while a refresh is queued.
A revision arriving during a refresh remains pending; a released lease cannot publish again.
Transactional dirty records roll back with source changes.
Event cursors bind filters, the observation window and committed publication sequence.
MySQL SELECT and lock budgets are restored before returning the connection.
Native asynchronous API and analytics worker publish and read persisted snapshots successfully.
Browser requests coalesce; one subscriber cannot cancel another and a late cancelled response cannot overwrite new data.
Product filtering displays its row before the independent statistics request changes from 202 to 200.
